description: Single source of error codes and categories (spec §13, error_contract_version 1). Error envelope: {status, error, error_code, category, remediation[, details]}; status/error keep their 0.x meaning. Every category except 'internal' keeps the 0.x CLI behaviour status INVALID_CALL / exit 3; 'internal' is status ERROR / exit 1 (an uncaught exception also exited 1 before). scope: 'envelope' = raised as an error; 'result' = reported inside a BLOCKED/INVALID tool result; 'runtime-report' = written to runtime evidence reports (execution/runtime/runtime-errors.md).

validation.description: The call itself is malformed: unknown tool, missing/unexpected/mistyped arguments, invalid values.

configuration.description: Caller-supplied configuration (UIUX_CONFIG, uiux.config.json, overrides) is invalid or asks for something unsupported.

unsupported.description: The operation is valid in general but not supported by this package/adapter.

package.description: The installed package is incomplete or inconsistent (manifest, version, package root).

registry.description: A registry (tools, knowledge, layers, capabilities, errors) is missing, unreadable or corrupt.

runtime.description: The optional runtime could not execute (server, readiness, capture), or a filesystem operation failed.

dependency.description: An optional runtime dependency of the target project is absent (never installed by the skill). Reported inside BLOCKED results; runtime_state tells declared-vs-installed apart.

internal.description: Unexpected failure inside the skill. No traceback in public output; set UIUX_DEBUG=1 to print it to stderr.

UNKNOWN_TOOL.remediation: Call `list_tools` (CLI: `uiux_cli.py tools`) and use a registered tool id.

MISSING_REQUIRED_ARGUMENT.remediation: Provide every argument listed in the tool's input.required.

UNEXPECTED_ARGUMENT.remediation: Remove arguments that are not declared in the tool's input.properties.

INVALID_ARGUMENT_TYPE.remediation: Pass a value of the JSON type declared in the tool's input schema.

INVALID_ARGUMENT.remediation: Use a value allowed by the tool's input schema and documentation (enum, range, vocabulary, existing path or id).

CONFIG_INVALID.remediation: Fix the configuration file: package-relative paths without '..', valid types, schema_version 1.

CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED.remediation: Remove the unsupported setting (e.g. dependency_policy.auto_install cannot be enabled).

UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION.remediation: Use an operation listed by the adapter or the capability map.

PACKAGE_ROOT_NOT_FOUND.remediation: Run from an intact package or set UIUX_ROOT to a directory containing SKILL.md.

MANIFEST_INVALID.remediation: Reinstall the package; the plugin manifest does not match schemas/plugin.schema.json.

VERSION_MISMATCH.remediation: Use matching components: VERSION, plugin manifest, CHANGELOG and adapter core_version must agree.

REGISTRY_INVALID.remediation: Reinstall the package or, in a source checkout, regenerate with `python scripts/knowledge_lib.py index`.

FILESYSTEM_ERROR.remediation: Check that the given paths exist and are readable/writable by the current user.

PLAYWRIGHT_IMPORT_FAILURE.remediation: Declare and install Playwright in the target project yourself (e.g. npm i -D @playwright/test) and make Node available; the skill never installs it.

PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSER_UNAVAILABLE.remediation: Install a Playwright browser build yourself (e.g. npx playwright install chromium); the skill never downloads browsers.

AXE_NOT_AVAILABLE.remediation: Add @axe-core/playwright or axe-core to the target project yourself; the skill never installs it.

SERVER_START_FAILURE.remediation: Start the application yourself, or pass allow_start with an explicit argv start.command.

READINESS_TIMEOUT.remediation: Make sure base_url responds before the readiness timeout.

BROWSER_LAUNCH_FAILURE.remediation: Check the Playwright installation and browser build of the target project.

NAVIGATION_FAILURE.remediation: Check the route, expected_selector and expected_text of the request.

BLANK_RENDER.remediation: The page rendered no content; check the application and authentication.

SCREENSHOT_FAILURE.remediation: Retry the capture; check timeouts and page stability.

PARTIAL_EXECUTION.remediation: Some captures failed; re-run only the failed routes/viewports.

ACCESSIBILITY_SCAN_FAILURE.remediation: The axe scan failed for a route/viewport; inspect accessibility-manifest.json.

AXE_RUNTIME_FAILURE.remediation: The axe helper failed; check Node, Playwright and axe in the target project.

INVALID_SCENARIO_SPEC.remediation: Provide valid actions and state validation targets conforming to interaction scenario specifications.

NO_HTML_ENTRYPOINT.remediation: Ensure an HTML entrypoint (e.g. index.html) exists in the target directory.

UNRESOLVED_SELECTOR.remediation: Check that the target element selector exists in the page DOM.

INTERNAL_ERROR.remediation: Report the issue; re-run with UIUX_DEBUG=1 to print the traceback to stderr.
